name: Elder Goldwell
summary: Near Kharanos, Elder Goldwell appears during the Lunar Festival. The ancient earthen spirit recalls the origins of modern dwarven civilization.

sections.title: A Spirit of the Earthen
sections.body: Elder Goldwell watches over the snowy slopes near Kharanos as a translucent earthen spirit. His stony form recalls the Titan-forged ancestors from whom the Bronzebeard clan descended. During the ancestor celebrations, travelers can honor that heritage in his presence.

faq.answer: Elder Goldwell is an earthen ancestor spirit who appears near Kharanos in Dun Morogh. During seasonal ancestor observances, travelers can pay respects to dwarven forebears.
Elder Goldwell stands outside Kharanos in Dun Morogh, usually near the local inn and gathering areas.

faq.q: Why does Elder Goldwell look like an earthen rather than a dwarf?
faq.answer: Dwarves trace their ancestry to the stone-skinned earthen created by the Titans. As an ancient spirit who honors past generations, Goldwell keeps the earthen form rather than the flesh of living dwarves.

angles.text: As a dwarf, meeting Elder Goldwell offers a rare look at your stone-wrought heritage and the lineage connecting modern Ironforge to the earthen.
As an Alliance traveler passing through Kharanos, you can seek out Goldwell to pay your respects and receive traditional blessings of good fortune.
